{
  "name": "lens",
  "description": "See images, SVGs and PDF pages in Claude Code where they appear: pasted, read, written or linked",
  "version": "0.2.2",
  "author": {
    "name": "minhdevtree",
    "url": "https://github.com/minhdevtree"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/minhdevtree/claude-lens",
  "repository": "https://github.com/minhdevtree/claude-lens",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "images",
    "pdf",
    "svg",
    "preview",
    "thumbnails",
    "mod",
    "terminal",
    "kitty",
    "claude-code"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "images": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Images",
      "description": "Preview PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, TIFF and HEIC files",
      "default": true
    },
    "svg": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "SVG",
      "description": "Preview SVG files",
      "default": true
    },
    "pdf": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "PDF",
      "description": "Preview PDF pages",
      "default": true
    },
    "pasted": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pasted images",
      "description": "above: thumbnails over the prompt while you draft, then under your message. inline: under your message only. pane: only in the /lens gallery",
      "options": [
        "above",
        "inline",
        "pane",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "above"
    },
    "read": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Files Claude reads",
      "description": "Where previews of files Claude reads show",
      "options": [
        "inline",
        "pane",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "inline"
    },
    "written": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Files Claude writes",
      "description": "Where previews of image, SVG and PDF files Claude writes (Write, Edit, Bash) show",
      "options": [
        "inline",
        "pane",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "inline"
    },
    "links": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Image links in replies",
      "description": "Where previews of local image paths in Claude's replies show",
      "options": [
        "inline",
        "pane",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "inline"
    },
    "toolImages": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Images tools return",
      "description": "Where screenshots and other images a tool returns (MCP, browser tools) show",
      "options": [
        "inline",
        "pane",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "inline"
    },
    "painter": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Drawing",
      "description": "auto: real pictures in kitty and Ghostty, colored blocks elsewhere. kitty: pictures only. blocks: colored blocks everywhere. text: file names only",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "kitty",
        "blocks",
        "text"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "detail": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Block detail",
      "description": "How fine the colored blocks are. auto: sextants (2x3 per cell) in CSM, quadrants (2x2) elsewhere. sextant needs a terminal that draws U+1FB00 glyphs (CSM, kitty, Ghostty, WezTerm). halfblock: 1x2, works everywhere",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "sextant",
        "quadrant",
        "halfblock"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "maxRows": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Thumbnail rows",
      "description": "Tallest a thumbnail may be, in terminal rows (2 to 40)",
      "default": 10
    },
    "pdfPages": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "PDF pages",
      "description": "How many pages of a PDF to show (1 to 8)",
      "default": 1
    }
  }
}
